name: Eden Valley

climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Eden Valley Riesling often shows a characteristic lime note.

blurb.text: A South Australian region in the Mount Lofty Ranges, within the Barossa zone, from Truro in the north to just south of Springton. High Eden lies inside it. Shiraz is 36 percent of plantings and Riesling 23 percent.
